user.title: Connect to UISP NMS
user.description: Create an API token in UISP under Settings → Users → API Tokens. A read-only token is enough for monitoring; switching PoE or ports needs a token with write access.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure UISP NMS
reconfigure.description: Change the URL or API token (leave the token blank to keep the current one). If UISP's certificate was replaced, submit unchanged to review and trust the new one.

trust_certificate.title: Trust UISP's certificate?
trust_certificate.description:
{host} uses a certificate that cannot be verified (UISP's default is self-signed). Its SHA-256 fingerprint is:

`{fingerprint}`

If this matches the certificate your UISP server uses, submit to trust exactly this certificate. Home Assistant will refuse to connect if it changes.

reauth_confirm.title: New UISP API token
reauth_confirm.description: UISP at {url} rejected the API token. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL starting with https://.
error.certificate: The certificate does not match the fingerprint.

abort.already_configured: This UISP server is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different UISP server; add it as a new integration instead.

poe_output_unknown.message: {port} offers more than one PoE output and the last one used is unknown. Choose it with the {port} PoE output entity, so the wrong voltage is never applied.

not_poe_switch.message: {entity_id} is not a UISP PoE switch.

poe_not_on.message: {entity_id} is off; only a port that is supplying power can be power-cycled.

power_cycle_port.name: Power-cycle port
power_cycle_port.description: Turns a port's PoE off, waits, and turns it back on with the same output. Useful to restart a stuck access point or camera.
